hooks.text: 跨时间线战争由崇尚绝对秩序的Guardians与追求终极自由的Escapers两种意识形态驱动
hooks.excerpt: One faction upholds order as the supreme law, calling themselves the "Guardians." They founded an corporation known as NeverCOM, whose branches stretch like a stellar network across the cosmos, imposing precise and unyielding control over countless timelines. In stark opposition stands another faction—known as the "Escapers"—who hold freedom as the ultimate truth of all existence.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 玩家既能探索发现新时间线，也能重新进入已经发现且仍在运行的时间线
hooks.excerpt: Players discover new timelines through the Explore Timeline function. ● Players re-enter already discovered and ongoing timelines via the Known Timelines function.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: Escapist通过降低稳定值尽快终结时间线，Guardian则提高稳定值让它活到预期寿命
hooks.excerpt: The goal of an Escapist is to end the timeline as quickly as possible by reducing its Stability Value, while the goal of a Guardian is to extend the timeline to its Expected Lifespan by increasing its Stability Value .
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
